# VEL Project Instructions

The authoritative, tool-neutral instructions for this repository are maintained in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

Before planning, editing, or reviewing code, read and follow `AGENTS.md`. It defines VEL's product scope, architecture boundaries, requirements conventions, documentation rules, contribution workflow, and validation requirements.

This file intentionally does not duplicate those rules. Update `AGENTS.md` when project-wide guidance changes.
